text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Hello, Aston Machan here. Today is the
last day
of summer camp.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
A lot's happened here. I almost came
down with a
heatstroke.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I also went out for a little walk with my
trainer.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
And I think we've gotten to know each
other a
little better.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...I took another step forward. And the
next is on
the way.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to keep up this momentum
into the fall.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
And that's all from Aston Machan on this
sunny
day.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...All right. That's my voice recording
done.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Huh? When did you get here, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, my summer camp experience
with Aston
Machan comes to a close.
